# Horizon Adult Health Care

> Horizon Adult Health Care provides comprehensive senior care services and PACE programs for elderly adults in Kentucky.

Horizon Adult Health Care is a Kentucky-based organization specializing in adult day health services, home care, and PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) programs. The organization is led by Kelly Upchurch and serves the aging population with compassionate, integrated care solutions.

## Key Topics

- PACE Program
- Adult Day Health Care
